question: Find the difference in total view counts between posts authored by users who have both 'Teacher' and 'Supporter' badges and those authored by users with the lowest reputation.

prediction.sql:
WITH TeacherSupporterUsers AS (
    SELECT b.XCL_002 AS user_id
    FROM badges b
    WHERE b.XCL_003 IN ('Teacher', 'Supporter')
    GROUP BY b.XCL_002
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.XCL_003) = 2
),
LowestRepUsers AS (
    SELECT u.XCL_052 AS user_id
    FROM users u
    WHERE u.XCL_053 = (SELECT MIN(XCL_053) FROM users)
),
GroupA_Sum AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.XCL_030), 0) AS total_views
    FROM posts p
    WHERE p.XCL_033 IN (SELECT user_id FROM TeacherSupporterUsers)
),
GroupB_Sum AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.XCL_030), 0) AS total_views
    FROM posts p
    WHERE p.XCL_033 IN (SELECT user_id FROM LowestRepUsers)
)
SELECT (SELECT total_views FROM GroupA_Sum) - (SELECT total_views FROM GroupB_Sum) AS difference
